to.implementation_strategy: Extend core/budget.py + budget_allocator.py with a reconciliation pass that sums per-artifact budgets from artifact-formats.json/config and compares to PIPELINE_MAX_TOTAL_TIME; expose over/under deltas via artifact reconciliation gate and /api/v1/artifacts manifest; reuse budget_conservation for conservation checks.
conflict_findings: BI-PF-0335 touches core/artifact_formats.py and reconciliation gate — coordinate merge order
Budget modules shared with scheduler/allocator work (BI-PF-1222) — serialize changes to core/budget*.py
duplication_findings: BI-PF-0335 already builds contract reconciliation artifact+gate — must extend, not duplicate
BI-0072 covers max_duration semantics — align total-time definitions to avoid drift
budget_planner/allocator already compute per-stage budgets — reuse rather than new math
to.rationale: Reconciliation is pure budget-summing over existing artifact contracts and the run budget constant; extending budget_* modules and the BI-PF-0335 gate satisfies it without new components.
assumptions: PIPELINE_MAX_TOTAL_TIME is the authoritative run budget
Per-artifact budgets are declared in artifact-formats config and are static per run
Over/under is informational, not a hard gate in v1
risks: Total-time definition mismatch between artifact budgets and pipeline elapsed (see BI-0072) may skew over/under results
HIL wait time inclusion could falsely report budget overrun
Concurrent edits to budget modules by scheduler epic may conflict
evidence: core/budget_allocator.py and budget_conservation.py already compute budget math
missing_info: Should over-budget block the run (gate) or only surface warnings?
Are artifact budgets advisory estimates or enforced contracts in v1?
Canonical total-time definition: wall clock vs compute-only excluding HIL wait
